summary: Iteration 50 — FRONTEND ONLY pass on the ONE MECHANIC / THREE FAMILIES doctrine (shared server re-derive on siding-kind). Seeded a fresh siding-kind estimate 'UI-PASS' via API with fascia_width_in=12 and hover_measurements (siding_sqft 2000 / eaves 120 / rakes 80 / soffit 200 / corners 4+2 / windows 10 / doors 2 / overhang 12), plus an lp_smart-kind estimate 'UI-PASS-LP' for regression sanity. ALL 8 test items PASS. Trade-specs card now renders on a siding-kind estimate with fascia-width-select AND rederive-now-btn, and LP-only controls (batten-spacing-select, panel-size-select, wrap-trim-width-select, shake-reveal-in) are correctly hidden. Clicking Re-derive on the seeded estimate produced the 'Re-derived from stored measurements' success toast and the '.019 Coil' row in Vinyl Soffit with Siding rendered qty=4 at fascia=12 (200 LF ÷ 50). Flipping fascia-width-select to 8" auto-triggered the server rederive via saveSpec and the coil row updated live to qty=2 (200 LF ÷ 100). Typing 9 into the coil qty input, letting it autosave, then clicking Re-derive preserved qty=9, rendered the 'human qty' chip (prov-human-Vinyl Soffit with Siding-.019 Coil) AND the violet 'yours-derived' chip (yours-derived-Vinyl Soffit with Siding-.019 Coil) reading literally 'yours: 9 · derived: 2' — human absolute doctrine confirmed. Overhang change 12→24 fired the server rederive with the toast 'overhang 12" → 24" — re-derived server-side (human-typed quantities preserved)' — the useRecalcSoffitOnOverhang hook is correctly using POST /rederive instead of local math. Order gate on siding-kind now renders: final-job-surface, gate-badge-quote, gate-badge-order, order-gate-items, order-flag-corner_locators, order-flag-blocking-corner_locators, order-flag-opening_schedule, order-flag-blocking-opening_schedule (order tier is live for vinyl estimates — previously blank). LP regression sanity clean: LP estimate loads, trade-spec-group renders all four LP dimensional selects (fascia-width-select, batten-spacing-select, panel-size-select, wrap-trim-width-select) plus the shake-reveal-in numeric input. Vinyl↔Ascend tab switch clean, no console errors on the estimate page (the 404s in console are a pre-existing catalog/preview asset noise unrelated to this pass — same as prior iterations).

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsRow.saveSpec (line 85–104) is now the ONE MECHANIC: after PUT, dispatches lp-flag-checklist-changed AND, for siding-kind, POSTs /rederive with the patch — same emitter for LP-kind (via LpMaterialListPanel's own listener) and siding-kind (via lines merge here). Doctrine is honored. Only nit: the code swallows /rederive errors silently for the spec-save path (catch {}). If measurements are missing that's fine (silent), but a 500 on a real bug would also be silent. Consider console.warn on non-409 errors so we notice regressions in the wild.

The manual rederiveNow (line 108–120) shows a toast on error (good) and a success toast that names the human-preserved count (good). Chip contract (SectionAccordion lines 265–273: renders yours-derived only when qty_src='human' AND derived_qty != qty) is clean.

Two .019 Coil rows exist in the 'Vinyl Soffit with Siding' section (backend returns qty=4 for both at fascia=12). Their data-testids collide ('qty-Vinyl Soffit with Siding-.019 Coil' appears twice in the DOM but Playwright only picked up one via query_selector_all → returned 1). Not a functional bug — the second row is likely rendered inside a variant/adder block or the second is filtered by section rules — but worth Howard's eye to confirm the visible tab isn't hiding one derived row. In our test the visible/queryable input carried the correct qty at every state (4 at fascia 12, 2 at fascia 8, 9 after human edit), so the mechanic itself is sound.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The shared server re-derive doctrine is UI-verified across siding-kind: spec-save auto path (fascia change), manual button path (Re-derive material list), and overhang path (useRecalcSoffitOnOverhang). Human qty absolute + violet 'yours: X · derived: Y' chip confirmed with live values (yours: 9 · derived: 2 at fascia 8). If future iterations add another SPEC-driven derivation (e.g. panel-size on Ascend), verify (a) it's included in the saveSpec patch, (b) buildPayload whitelists the field (persistent silent-strip class of bug per iter 48), (c) the shared /rederive endpoint honors it. For chip contract regression: qty_src='human' + derived_qty != qty are BOTH required for the violet chip to render. Two .019 Coil rows co-exist in Vinyl Soffit with Siding with identical data-testids — use .first when writing further Playwright.
